name: 김대현
title: 큐브 코치: 웹캠으로 손에 든 큐브를 매 프레임 추적하며 음성으로 풀이를 안내하는 코치
data_type: image (video frames: 3D synthetic cube scenes + real camera background patches, pixel-wise segmentation)
models: PixelMLP (baseline, 1x1 conv 3 layers on 4x4 cell colors)
CubeSegNet v1 (same architecture, trained on synthetic data only)
CubeSegNet v2 (proposed, final: depthwise-separable encoder-decoder, 170,025 params, ONNX 664KB)

primary_metric.name: Real-frame sticker color accuracy (test set: 40 frames, 723 cells)
